python3 - <<'EOF'
p = "Alligators Cinematic Cut.tsx"
s = open(p).read()
reps = [
 ("54 + 34 + 50 + 54 + 40 + 38 + 18 + 16 + 16 + 18 + 40 + 56 + 34 + 66 + 46 + 66 + 68; // = 714 (23.8s)",
  "54 + 34 + 50 + 54 + 40 + 38 + 18 + 16 + 16 + 18 + 40 + 30 + 34 + 66 + 46 + 66 + 68; // = 688 (22.9s)"),
 ("1280×720 · 30fps · ~24s", "1280×720 · 30fps · ~23s"),
 ('from={378} durationInFrames={56} name="huddle"', 'from={378} durationInFrames={30} name="huddle"'),
 ('from={434} durationInFrames={34} name="coach"', 'from={408} durationInFrames={34} name="coach"'),
 ('from={468} durationInFrames={66} name="value-bars"', 'from={442} durationInFrames={66} name="value-bars"'),
 ('from={534} durationInFrames={46} name="join-us"', 'from={508} durationInFrames={46} name="join-us"'),
 ('from={580} durationInFrames={66} name="cta-walk"', 'from={554} durationInFrames={66} name="cta-walk"'),
 ('from={646} durationInFrames={68} name="crest"', 'from={620} durationInFrames={68} name="crest"'),
 ('from={378} durationInFrames={56} name="fx-leak-huddle"', 'from={378} durationInFrames={30} name="fx-leak-huddle"'),
 ('from={384} durationInFrames={46} name="fx-title-srdce"', 'from={384} durationInFrames={24} name="fx-title-srdce"'),
 ('from={436} durationInFrames={30} name="fx-lt-bratrstvi"', 'from={410} durationInFrames={30} name="fx-lt-bratrstvi"'),
 ('from={588} durationInFrames={58} name="fx-cta"', 'from={562} durationInFrames={58} name="fx-cta"'),
 ('from={654} durationInFrames={60} name="fx-crest-graphics"', 'from={628} durationInFrames={60} name="fx-crest-graphics"'),
]
for a,b in reps:
    assert s.count(a)==1, a
    s = s.replace(a,b)
open(p,"w").write(s)
EOF
